Aerial Retreat.name: Retirada aérea
Aerial Retreat.description:
The hippogriff makes a talon Golpe, then Flies with a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its fly Velocidad. The hippogriff and its rider gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.evvqmXIieuMwFMJT]{Efecto: Retirada (jinete)}

Antler Catapult.name: Catapulta de cornamenta
Antler Catapult.description: The elk Steps once and then makes an antlers Golpe. If it moved and hits, the elk can fling its objetivo into the space it just left, which is forced movement.

Badger Rage.name: Furia de tejón
Badger Rage.description:
Requisitos The badger isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or raging.

The badger enters a state of pure rage that lasts for 1 minuto, until there are no enemigos it can perceive, or until it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}, whichever comes first. It can't voluntarily stop raging. While raging, the badger is affected in the following ways.

  • It deals 4 daño adicional with its bite attacks and 2 daño adicional with its claw attacks.
  • It takes a –1 penalizador to AC.
  • It can't use actions that have the concentrate rasgo. The animal companion can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} even while raging. After it has stopped raging, it can't use Badger Rage again for 1 minuto.

Bay.name: Aullido
Bay.description: The shadow hound releases an eerie bay, attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each foe in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]. Estos Demoralize attempts don't require a language and don't take any penalizador due to not sharing a language.

Bear Hug.name: Abrazo de oso
Bear Hug.description:
Requisitos The bear's last action was a successful claw Golpe.

The bear makes another claw Golpe against the same objetivo. If this Golpe hits, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado}, as if the bear had successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grappled} el objetivo.

Blood Feast.name: Festín de sangre
Blood Feast.description:
Tu compañero animal vampírico ataca a un enemigo sangrante y bebe su sangre. Tu compañero da un Golpe contra la criatura, que sufre daño persistente por sangrado. El Golpe causa 2d8 daño adicional. Si el Golpe acierta y causa daño, tu compañero vampírico obtiene tantos Puntos de Golpe temporales como la mitad de tu nivel durante 1 minuto.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.q6fSAYeFEf1B5Bu7]{Efecto: Festín de sangre}

Boar Charge.name: Carga de jabalí
Boar Charge.description: The boar Strides twice in a straight line and then makes a tusk Golpe. As long as it moved at least 20 pies, it gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to its tirada de ataque.

Bony Constriction.name: Constricción ósea
Bony Constriction.description:
Requisitos The constrictor has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado}.

The skeletal constrictor deals @Damage[12[piercing]] daño to the grabbed criatura with its sharp ribs; the criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:bony-constriction] salvación. If the constrictor is a specialized companion, increase this daño to @Damage[20[piercing]|shortLabel]. Este uses a entrenado DC using the constrictor's Constitution modifier, or an experto DC if the constrictor is specialized.

Bouncing Slam.name: Golpe rebotador
Bouncing Slam.description: The gibtas Leaps toward a Medium or smaller criatura, landing in the criatura's space and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoving} the criatura. If the Shove fails, the gibtas bounces out of el objetivo's square to an adjacent square of el objetivo's choosing.

Bounding Retreat.name: Retirada a saltos
Bounding Retreat.description: The antelope Leaps twice. If it has a rider, it can leave them in an empty space as it Leaps out of it.

Breach.name: Salto fuera del agua
Breach.description: The orca Swims up to its swim Velocidad, then Leaps vertically out of the water up to 25 pies in the air, making a Golpe against a criatura at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a criatura within 30 pies of the water's surface). After the Golpe, the orca splashes back down into the water.

Bucking Frenzy.name: Frenesí de coces
Bucking Frenzy.description: The war pig transforms any fear it feels into fury before kicking wildly. Reduce the war pig's asustado value by 1 (minimum 0). The war pig then makes hoof Golpes against up to three different foes within its reach. Estos Golpes each take a –2 penalizador to their tiradas de ataque unless the war pig began its turn with the asustado condition. Each attack counts toward the war pig's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador only increases after all the attacks have been made.

Burrowing Ambush.name: Emboscada excavadora
Burrowing Ambush.description: Tu mole Burrows and makes a Golpe. If the mole began its movement underground, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} for this attack.

Careful Withdraw.name: Retirada cuidadosa
Careful Withdraw.description: The legchair carefully extricates tú from a dangerous situation. It Steps twice and then Strides.

Cat Pounce.name: Abalanzamiento felino
Cat Pounce.description: The cat Strides and then Golpes. If it was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Sin detectar} at the start of its Cat Pounce, it remains sin detectar until after the attack.

Circling Flyby.name: Pasada circular
Circling Flyby.description: Tu air elemental flies in a circle, blowing gusts at tu foes before returning back to its starting position. The air elemental Flies up to half its Velocidad, makes two gust Golpes, then Flies up to half its Velocidad again to return to its original location. Both attacks count toward the air elemental's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador doesn't increase until after it makes both attacks.

Constrict.name: Constreñir
Constrict.description:
Requisitos The snake has a smaller criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado}.

The snake deals @Damage[12[bludgeoning]] daño to the grabbed criatura; the criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|basic] salvación against tu class DC. If the snake is a specialized animal companion, increase this daño to @Damage[20[bludgeoning]|shortLabel].

Crab Cannon.name: Cañón cangrejo
Crab Cannon.description: Tu durian crab curls itself up tightly, taking the shape of a ball. It then launches itself with its powerful claw at a objetivo within 20 pies. When it lands, it makes a claw Golpe, except the daño is bludgeoning instead of piercing. On a hit, el objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} for 1 asalto and the Golpe deals an additional @Damage[1d8[untyped]] daño, or 2d8 daño adicional if tu crab is specialized.

Darting Attack.name: Ataque veloz
Darting Attack.description: The raptor Steps up to 10 pies and then Golpes, or Golpes and then Steps up to 10 pies.

Darting Stab.name: Aguijonazo veloz
Darting Stab.description: The giant wasp Flies up to 15 pies and then Golpes, or Golpes and then Flies up to 15 pies.

Death Roll.name: Giro mortal
Death Roll.description:
Requisitos The crocodile has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado}.

The crocodile tucks its legs and rolls rapidly, twisting its victim. It makes a jaws Golpe with a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to the tirada de ataque against the grabbed criatura. If it hits, it also knocks the criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}. If it misses, it releases the criatura.

Death from Above.name: Muerte desde arriba
Death from Above.description: The flying squirrel crashes down onto a objetivo, furiously clawing at it. The flying squirrel falls to an empty space next to el objetivo, taking no daño, and makes two claw Golpes. Both attacks count toward its multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador doesn't increase until after both attacks have been made.

Defensive Curl.name: Ovillo defensivo
Defensive Curl.description: The pangolin coils into a ball to defend itself. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC. Any criatura that hits the pangolin with a melee ataque sin armas while it's in its Defensive Curl take [[/r 2d6[persistent,bleed]]] daño. The pangolin can't move, use its ataques sin armas, or take other actions that require it to use its limbs while in its Defensive Curl, but it can unfurl as a single action, ending the effects of Defensive Curl.

Defensive Curl (Hermit Krait).name: Ovillo defensivo (krait ermitaño)
Defensive Curl (Hermit Krait).description: The hermit krait pulls its heads into its shell to protect itself. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC and a +4 bonificador de circunstancia to any prueba to pretend to be a mundane shell. Any criatura that hits the hermit krait with a melee ataque sin armas while it's in its Defensive Curl takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] daño as one of the krait's heads lashes out from within the shell. While in its shell, the hermit krait can't move or take other actions that require using its limbs, but it can extend out of the shell as a single action, ending the effects of Defensive Curl.

Disgusting Gallop.name: Galope repugnante
Disgusting Gallop.description:
The zombie mount Strides twice, spraying putrid spittle as it runs. Once during this movement, elige a criatura adjacent to the zombie mount. The spittle splashes on it, and the criatura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:disgusting-gallop] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1}.

The criatura is then temporarily immune to the spittle for 24 horas. Este uses a entrenado DC using the zombie mount's Constitution modifier, or an experto DC if the mount is specialized.

Distracting Spray.name: Rocío distractor
Distracting Spray.description:
The capybara sprays an adjacent objetivo with its scent glands. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:distracting-spray] salvación. Wiping off the musk takes an Interactuar action and ends the effect. Este uses a entrenado DC using the capybara's Constitution modifier or an experto DC if the capybara is specialized.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} for 1 asalto.

Fallo The criatura is torpe 1 for 1 minuto.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} for 1 minuto.

Diving Skewer.name: Ensartar en picado
Diving Skewer.description: The wyvern Flies up to half its Velocidad and then makes a stinger Golpe. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}. If the Golpe critically succeeds, el objetivo also takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] daño.

Drench.name: Empapar
Drench.description: Tu water elemental drenches nearby fires to extinguish them. Tu elemental puts out all fires in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. It extinguishes all non-magical fires automatically and attempts to counteract magical fires (its counteract modifier is equal to its attack modifier with its wave Golpe, unmodified by any bonuses or effects that apply to tiradas de ataque).

Enamoring Exhalation.name: Exhalación cautivadora
Enamoring Exhalation.description: Tu riding dragonet enraptures those nearby, exhaling a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] of pheromones that fascinates those within it. Each criatura in the area is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado} with tú and tu dragonet until the end of tu next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|against:enamoring-exhalation|basic:true] salvación. Este uses a entrenado DC using the dragonet's Charisma modifier, or an experto DC if the dragonet is specialized.

Extend Pseudopod.name: Extender seudópodo
Extend Pseudopod.description: Tu chair lengthens itself, granting its pseudopod Golpe the reach 10 pies rasgo until the beginning of tu next turn.

Feast on the Fallen.name: Festín de los caídos
Feast on the Fallen.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Desencadenante A criatura adjacent to the vulture is reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe

The vulture consumes a piece of the defeated foe, regaining @Damage[18[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. If the vulture is a specialized animal companion, increase the Puntos de Golpe regained to @Damage[30[healing]|shortLabel].

Fire Breath.name: Aliento de fuego
Fire Breath.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

The riding drake breathes a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] of fire, dealing @Damage[(max(1,floor(@actor.nivel/2)))d6[fire]|options:area-damage]{1d6 daño de fuego for every 2 levels} the drake has to all criaturas in the area (@Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect|against:fire-breath] salvación). Este uses a entrenado DC using the drake's Constitution modifier or an experto DC if the drake is specialized.

Flamethrower.name: Lanzallamas
Flamethrower.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutos

The fire elemental makes a tendril Golpe against all criaturas in a @Template[type:line|distance:60], even those that aren't in the tendril Golpe's reach. All these Golpes count toward the fire elemental's multiple attack penalizador, but it doesn't increase until all the Golpes.

Float.name: Flotar
Float.description:
Desencadenante The umbrella mushroom is falling.

The umbrella mushroom inflates buoyant air bladders and begins rotating to arrest the fall. It slows its descent to 60 pies per round. It can take this reaction even when @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}.

Flower Dance.name: Danza floral
Flower Dance.description: The sundaflora stands tall on its hind legs and begins to wave and dance, showing off its dazzling beauty to distract tu attackers. It attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} el objetivo criatura, using its [[/act feint skill=performance]]{Performance } skill instead of Deception. If successful (or critically successful), el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to tú, rather than to tu sundaflora.

Flyby Attack.name: Ataque al pasar volando
Flyby Attack.description: The bird Flies and makes a talon Golpe at any point along the way.

Flying Strafe.name: Pasada rasante
Flying Strafe.description: The griffon Flies up to its fly Velocidad and makes two talon Golpes at any point, each against a different criatura.

Frightening Display.name: Exhibición aterradora
Frightening Display.description: Tu ape makes a loud and frightening display, throwing a foe off balance. The ape attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} el objetivo criatura; this display gains the visual rasgo and doesn't require language. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} by this ability, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to tu ape.

Gallop.name: Galope
Gallop.description: The horse Strides twice at a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to Velocidad.

Gnash.name: Desgarrar con los dientes
Gnash.description:
Requisitos The severed head's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

Tu severed head violently shakes itself back and forth, trying to tear away a mouthful of flesh. It makes another jaws Golpe against the same objetivo. If the Golpe hits, it deals @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] daño in addition to its usual daño.

Gnaw.name: Roer
Gnaw.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

The Golpe's objetivo takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] daño and takes a –10-pies penalizador de estado to its Velocidad until it removes the daño de sangrado. If the hyena is a specialized animal companion, the daño persistente de sangrado increases to @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]|shortLabel].

Go For the Eyes!.name: ¡A por los ojos!
Go For the Eyes!.description:
The squox Strides, attempts an @Check[acrobatics|against:perception] prueba against an adjacent criatura's Perception DC, and then makes a jaws Golpe.

Éxito crítico Thrown by the squox's sudden leap, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the end of the squox's next turn.

Éxito El objetivo is only momentarily startled and is desprevenido until the end of the squox's current turn.

Fallo crítico The squox misjudges the distance to its objetivo's face and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Grab and Sting.name: Agarrar y aguijonear
Grab and Sting.description: The scorpion holds its foe in place with its pincers in order to sting it. It makes a pincer Golpe. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo criatura automatically becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} by the scorpion, which then makes a stinger Golpe against it. The grabbed condition lasts until the end of tu next turn.

Grabbing Branches.name: Ramas apresadoras
Grabbing Branches.description: Tu wood elemental surrounds a foe with branches, grabbing it in place. Tu wood elemental makes a branch Golpe; on a success, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} by the wood elemental until the end of tu next turn unless tu wood elemental moves or el objetivo Escapes.

Grabbing Trunk.name: Trompa apresadora
Grabbing Trunk.description: The elephant grabs its foe with its trunk and carries it off. The elephant uses Athletics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a criatura up to two sizes smaller than the elephant in its trunk. If its objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado}, the elephant repositions el objetivo to another space in the elephant's reach.

Grip Throat.name: Agarrar la garganta
Grip Throat.description: The hand attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a Medium or smaller criatura by the throat. If the Grapple succeeds, in addition to the normal effects, the criatura has difficulty speaking. While it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} by the hand, it must spend an extra action to perform any action that has the verbal rasgo.

Gulp Blood.name: Tragar sangre
Gulp Blood.description:
Requisitos The water wraith's last action was a successful jaws attack against a foe.

The water wraith gains 2d8 Puntos de Golpe temporales that last for 1 asalto, and the foe takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] daño. If the water wraith has a specialization, the water wraith instead gains 3d8 Puntos de Golpe temporales, and el objetivo takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,bleed]] daño. If the targeted criatura has absolutely no vital fluids, this ability might not function, at the GM's discretion.

Hair Barrage.name: Descarga de pelos
Hair Barrage.description: The tarantula flicks its legs, flinging spiky hairs in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Este deals @Damage[(4 + max(0,floor((@actor.nivel - 6) / 4)))d6[piercing]] daño with a @Check[type:reflex|against:hair-barrage|basic:true]. Este uses a entrenado DC using the tarantula's Dexterity modifier or an experto DC if the tarantula is specialized. Este daño increases by an additional 1d6 for every 4 levels tienes beyond 6th.

Hustle.name: Aligerar
Hustle.description: The beetle moves at incredible speed. It Strides three times.

Knock Aside.name: Apartar de un golpe
Knock Aside.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful headbutt Golpe.

The goat automatically pushes el objetivo back 5 pies, or 10 pies if the required Golpe was a impacto crítico.

Liberating Bite.name: Mordisco liberador
Liberating Bite.description: The mongoose makes a jaws Golpe that can help criaturas break free of restraint, like the grasp of a cobra. If the Golpe hits, each criatura grappled or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} by el objetivo can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as a free action.

Lizard Leap.name: Salto de lagarto
Lizard Leap.description: The keulia Leaps and then makes a bite Golpe. As long as it moved at least 10 pies, its Golpe deals an additional @Damage[1d6[piercing]] daño, or @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño if tu keulia is nimble or savage.

Lock Jaw.name: Mandíbula trabada
Lock Jaw.description:
Requisitos The boarhound's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

El objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado}, as if the boarhound successfully Grappled el objetivo.

Long Stomp.name: Pisotón largo
Long Stomp.description: Tu giraffe Strides twice and then makes a hoof Golpe. As long as it moved at least 20 pies, it deals an additional @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño. Increase this to @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|shortLabel] if tu giraffe is specialized.

Lumbering Knockdown.name: Derribo pesado
Lumbering Knockdown.description: Tu triceratops Strides up to 10 pies, then makes a horns Golpe. On a success, el objetivo is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Lurching Rush.name: Carga tambaleante
Lurching Rush.description: The monitor lizard Strides and then makes a jaws Golpe. If it moved at least 20 pies away from its starting position, it gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to this tirada de ataque.

Overwhelm.name: Abrumar
Overwhelm.description: The tyrannosaurus bears down on an enemigo and pins it with its jaws. The tyrannosaurus makes a jaws Golpe; on a hit, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado}

Pick at the Meat.name: Picotear la carne
Pick at the Meat.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

Tu bird picks at the wound it just created. El objetivo of its jaws Golpe takes @Damage[1d8[bleed]] daño, or @Damage[2d8[bleed]] daño if the bird is specialized.

Poisonous Sweep.name: Barrido venenoso
Poisonous Sweep.description: The salamander secretes poison from the glands on its tail and bludgeons an enemigo to apply it to them. It makes a tail Golpe. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo takes an additional @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] daño. If tu salamander is nimble or savage, increase this daño to @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] daño.

Possessing Strike.name: Golpe posesivo
Possessing Strike.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Tu gray bladeling attempts to inject a malevolent soul fragment into a victim to seize control of their actions. The gray bladeling makes a blade Golpe against a living criatura. If it hits and deals daño, el objetivo must attempt a Will salvación against tu class DC or conjuro DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, el objetivo is temporarily immune to Possessing Golpe for 24 horas.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo fights off the possessing soul fragment but is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} for 1 asalto and can't use offensive actions against tú or tu gray bladeling.

Fallo crítico As failure, but if el objetivo takes daño from an attack or conjuro, the DC of the prueba plana to recover from the confusion is 15.

Pterosaur Swoop.name: Picado de pterosaurio
Pterosaur Swoop.description: The pterosaur Flies up to its Velocidad and makes one beak Golpe at any point during that movement.

Raging Stampede.name: Estampida furiosa
Raging Stampede.description: The yzobu Strides and then makes a horn Golpe. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo is pushed 10 pies.

Rhinoceros Charge.name: Carga de rinoceronte
Rhinoceros Charge.description: The rhino Strides and makes a horn Golpe at the end of its Zancada. As long as the rhino moved at least 20 pies, the horn Golpe deals 1d8 daño adicional perforante, or 2d8 daño adicional if tu rhino is nimble or savage.

Rolling Charge.name: Carga rodante
Rolling Charge.description: The cragstone bear tucks itself into a ball and Strides twice in a straight line. It can make a slam Golpe against one criatura it's adjacent to at any point during this movement. If the Golpe is a impacto crítico, el objetivo is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Rolling Knockdown.name: Derribo rodante
Rolling Knockdown.description: Tu earth elemental rolls along the ground like a bowling ball and knocks a foe over. It Strides up to 10 pies then makes a fist Golpe. If it hits, el objetivo is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Sand Stride.name: Zancada de arena
Sand Stride.description: The camel Strides twice with a +5-pies bonificador de circunstancia to Velocidad, ignoring difficult terrain caused by rubble, sand, and uneven ground made of earth and stone.

Screaming Skull.name: Calavera aulladora
Screaming Skull.description:
El esqueleto se quita la calavera y la lanza, dando un Golpe de mandíbulas con alcance 20 pies (6 m). Sin importar si acierta o no, el objetivo y todos los enemigos a 10 pies (3 m) deben realizar una salvación de @Check[will|against:screaming-skull] o quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}, o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} con un fallo crítico. Esto utiliza la CD entrenada del modificador por Carisma del esqueleto o experta si el esqueleto está especializado.

Al inicio del siguiente turno del esqueleto, la cabeza bota, rueda o vuela para volver a fijarse al cuerpo. El esqueleto queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Ciego} mientras su cabeza está lejos.

Scurry.name: Corretear
Scurry.description: Tu chetamog takes any combination of two Zancada or Climb actions. It has a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its Velocidad during these Strides.

Seedpod Spring.name: Resorte de vaina
Seedpod Spring.description: A seedpod within the chair bursts and uncoils, releasing a light clump of cottony material. Tu rootball chair Leaps up to 30 pies vertically or horizontally and drifts down, sinking 5 pies for every 5 pies traveled horizontally and causing tú to take no falling daño. The cottony material disperses when tú land.

Shred.name: Desgarrar
Shred.description: The shark viciously rips into the wound. El objetivo of the shark's Golpe takes @Damage[1d8[slashing]] daño (@Damage[2d8[slashing]|shortLabel] for a mature shark or @Damage[3d8[slashing]|shortLabel] for a specialized companion).

Snatch.name: Arrebatar
Snatch.description: The roc Golpes a criatura with its talon and then attempts to Grab the criatura. If the Grab is successful, the roc then Flies up to half its speed, carrying that criatura along with it.

Snatch and Zap.name: Arrebatar y descargar
Snatch and Zap.description: The Ulgrem-Lurann bites down hard and unleashes an electrical discharge. It makes a jaws Golpe. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo criatura automatically becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} by the Ulgrem-Lurann and takes @Damage[1d4[electricity]] daño (@Damage[2d4[electricity]|shortLabel] for a mature Ulgrem-Lurann or @Damage[3d4[electricity]|shortLabel] for a specialized companion). The grabbed condition lasts until the end of tu next turn, though the Ulgrem-Lurann can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} to attempt to extend the duration as normal.

Spiked Bunker.name: Búnker de púas
Spiked Bunker.description: Tu metal elemental surrounds itself with protective metal spikes, hunkering down defensively. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC. Any criatura that hits the metal elemental with a melee ataque sin armas while it's in its Spiked Bunker takes @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño (or @Damage[3d6[piercing]] daño if tu metal elemental has a specialization). The metal elemental can't move, Golpe, or take other actions that require it to use its body while in its Spiked Bunker, but it can retract the bunker as a single action, ending the effects.

Spit.name: Escupir
Spit.description: The bacallia regurgitates a portion of its stomach's contents as a ranged spit Golpe that deals a base of 1d6 daño de ácido with a range increment of 10 pies. The daño is 2d6 for a mature bacallia and 3d6 for a specialized one. A living criatura hit with this Golpe is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} on a impacto crítico).

Spring Kick.name: Patada de resorte
Spring Kick.description: The kangaroo balances on its tail and lashes out with a powerful two-legged kick. The kangaroo makes a pies Golpe. If it hits, el objetivo is pushed back 10 pies. On a impacto crítico, they are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Suction Vortex.name: Vórtice de succión
Suction Vortex.description:
Requisitos The ravenous drake doesn't have a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} in its jaws

Efecto The ravenous drake draws in a powerful intake of breath, attempting to pull a foe within 10 pies toward it. The drake attempts an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] prueba against the foe's CD de Fortaleza. On a success, the ravenous drake pulls the foe up to 10 pies to be adjacent to it. Este movement is forced movement. On a critical success, the foe is also grabbed by the drake's jaws until the beginning of tu next turn.

Sudden Retreat.name: Retirada súbita
Sudden Retreat.description:
The hippocampus makes a tail Golpe, then Swims with a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its swim Velocidad. The hippocampus and its rider gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.evvqmXIieuMwFMJT]{Efecto: Retirada (jinete)}

Swimming Snap.name: Mordisco nadador
Swimming Snap.description: The giant eel Swims and makes a jaws Golpe at any point along the way.

Tail Escape.name: Escape de cola
Tail Escape.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutos

Requisitos The giant rock tuatara is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado}.

The giant rock tuatara detaches its tail to free itself from an enemigo's grip. It automatically Escapes and can Dar un paso. It then can't use its tail slam Golpe until it can regenerate its tail, which takes 10 minutos or an application of healing magic that restores Puntos de Golpe.

Tail Swipe.name: Barrido de cola
Tail Swipe.description: Tu draft lizard sweeps its tail, making tail Golpes against up to two adjacent foes. Each attack counts toward the draft lizard's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador only increases after all the attacks have been made.

Take a Taste.name: Prueba un poco
Take a Taste.description:
Requisitos El zombi tiene a una criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresada} o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizada}.

El zombi trata de agarrar y morder a la criatura. El zombi hace un Golpe de mandíbulas contra la criatura. Este Golpe usa las mismas estadísticas que su Golpe de cuerpo a cuerpo normal, excepto que el daño es 1d10 e inflige daño perforante.

Takedown.name: Derribo
Takedown.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

The wolf automatically knocks el objetivo of its jaws Golpe @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Tearing Clutch.name: Presa desgarradora
Tearing Clutch.description: The terror bird makes a beak Golpe; on a successful hit, el objetivo takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] daño.

Telekinetic Assault.name: Asalto telecinético
Telekinetic Assault.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

El fantasma lanza una ráfaga de emociones, causando que los objetos pequeños y los escombros vuelen en una emanación de 20 pies (6 m), causando @Damage[(floor(@actor.nivel / 2))d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]{1d6 daño contundente por cada 2 niveles} que tenga el fantasma (salvación @Check[reflex|basic|against:telekinetic-assault|options:area-effect]). Esto utiliza una CD entrenada del modificador de Carisma del fantasma o experta si el fantasma está especializado.

Telepathic Pounce.name: Abalanzamiento telepático
Telepathic Pounce.description:
The shotalashu hunts by pinning its foes with not just its claws, but with its mind as well. One criatura within 30 pies must attempt a @Check[will|against:telepathic-pounce] salvación, with the following effects. Este uses a entrenado DC using the shotalashu's Charisma modifier or an experto DC if the shotalashu is specialized.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes a –5 pies penalizador de estado to its Velocidades for one round.

Fallo The criatura takes a –10 pies penalizador de estado to its Velocidades for one round. The shotalashu can then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} for one round. The shotalashu can then Leap.

Throw Rock.name: Arrojar roca
Throw Rock.description: The arboreal sapling Interacts to pick up a rock within reach or retrieve a stowed rock, then throws it with a ranged rock Golpe that deals a base of 1d6 daño contundente with a range increment of 30 pies. The daño is 2d6 for a mature arboreal sapling and 3d6 for a specialized one.

Tongue Grab.name: Agarre de lengua
Tongue Grab.description: The giant frog lashes out with its tongue, making a tongue Golpe. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} by the giant frog and pulled into a square adjacent to the frog. The grabbed condition lasts until the end of tu next turn.

Tongue Pull.name: Tirón de lengua
Tongue Pull.description: The cave gecko snaps out its tongue, attempting to pull a foe within 10 pies toward it. The gecko attempts an Athletics prueba against the foe's CD de Fortaleza. On a success, the cave gecko pulls the foe next to it. Este movement is forced movement. On a critical success, the foe is also @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado} until the beginning of tu next turn.

Ultrasonic Scream.name: Grito ultrasónico
Ultrasonic Scream.description:
The moth flaps its wings and emits ultrasonic squeaks that scramble the senses of nearby criaturas. Elige one criatura within 30 pies of the moth. That criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:ultrasonic-scream] salvación. Este uses a entrenado DC using the moth's Constitution modifier or an experto DC if the moth is specialized.

Éxito El objetivo treats all criaturas as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} on its next attack before the start of tu next turn.

Fallo El objetivo treats all criaturas as oculto until the start of tu next turn.

Fallo crítico As failure, and el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

Unnerving Screech.name: Chirrido inquietante
Unnerving Screech.description:
Tu skeletal bird of prey makes an earsplitting, unnatural screech, deafening and startling an enemigo within 30 pies. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[fortitude] salvación. El objetivo is then temporarily immune for 1 hora. The asustado condition is a mental, emotion, and fear effect, but the criatura can still be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Ensordecido} if it's immune to these.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is deafened for 1 asalto and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo El objetivo is deafened for 1 minuto and asustado 1.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is deafened for 10 minutos and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Weighted Kick.name: Patada cargada
Weighted Kick.description: Tu augdunar gives a heavy kick with its hind legs, bringing the weight of its burden on el objetivo. It makes a hoof Golpe. On a successful hit, the augdunar automatically Shoves el objetivo back 5 pies (10 pies on a critical success).

Wing Thrash.name: Batir de alas
Wing Thrash.description: The bat thrashes wildly with its wings, making wing Golpes against up to three adjacent foes. Each attack counts toward the bat's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador only increases after all the attacks have been made.

Wrapping Tendrils.name: Zarcillos envolventes
Wrapping Tendrils.description:
Requisitos The urchinpad's last action was a successful tendril Golpe.

The urchinpad makes another tendril Golpe against the same objetivo. If this Golpe hits, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresado}, as if the urchinpad had successfully Grappled el objetivo.
